title: Dua Lipa Opens Up About ‘Magical’ Wedding Day & 2 Pieces of Advice She & Callum Turner Followed
summary: The pop star and actor tied the knot in Sicily in June.
body: Dua Lipa’s wedding day had her levitating. The pop star and Callum Turner tied the knot during a dreamy ceremony in Palermo, Italy, in June, and Dua reflected on the “magical” day while gracing the September cover of Vogue Italia on Monday (Aug. 24). Related Dua Lipa Soaks Up Newlywed Life With Callum Turner in Intimate Honeymoon Photos: ‘Heaven on Earth’ Dua Lipa and Callum Turner Share Stunning Wedding Photos From Ceremony in Sicily Dua Lipa and Callum Turner Celebrate Second Wedding Ceremony in Sicily “The wedding day was magical,” she gushed. “We received so much advice, but we decided to follow just two pieces of it: to experience the day as if we were guests ourselves and to constantly seek each other out in the crowd, never losing sight of one another. That way, we really have so many memories together.” After a small civil ceremony in London in May, Dua and Turner danced the night away with a beautiful wedding on the coast of Sicily. The Grammy-winning star stunned in a custom Chanel haute couture dress designed by Matthieu Blazy, which reportedly took more than 1,000 hours to perfect. The Palermo wedding…

title: Razer’s 11-in-1 USB-C dock just crashed to $52 in by far its best deal yet
summary: Amazon slashed the Razer USB-C Dock from $129.99 to $52, with 11 ports, 85W charging, and a travel-ready design.
body: Amazon has dropped the Razer USB-C Dock to just $52, and that is a huge cut from its $129.99 recommended retail price. That works out to $77.99 off, or 60% off RRP. We’ve never even seen it fall much below $80 in its previous best deals, so it’s worth catching this offer while it lasts. See the deal at Amazon
